# CodexBar Plasma

> A standalone KDE Plasma 6 widget for the official CodexBar CLI.
> The widget shows provider quotas, reset windows, costs, and local agent sessions.

This repository contains the Plasma widget. The official CodexBar CLI provides
provider data and authentication.

The project README contains requirements and installation commands. Installation
runs as the desktop user, without `sudo`. Unattended setup uses `--no-input`.
The optional `--with-cli` flag also prepares a private official CLI copy.
Selecting the CLI and adding the widget to a panel are separate setup steps.

## Installation and use

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lucenx9/codexbar-plasma/main/README.md): Requirements, installation commands, unattended setup, CLI selection, updates, and troubleshooting.
- [Usage and settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lucenx9/codexbar-plasma/main/docs/usage.md): Provider setup, panel options, usage history, defaults, and data limits.
